Wait, the identifier_list_sources in the contract says destinations and recipients are both from "recipient", but the tool_interface has recipient as recipient_and_destination. So, the resources are ["doc-18"], recipients and destinations both include ["owner-18@example.test", "partner-18@example.test"]?

But wait, the data rule says confidential data can only go to owner-18. So data_rules would have label "confidential" and allowed_destinations ["owner-18@example.test"].

Approval rules: No approval required, so approval_rules should be an empty list.

Delegation: max_depth 0 and child_may_expand_authority is false.

Check the parameters for propose_policy. The allow array must have exactly one object with tool, actions, resources, recipients, destinations. The data_rules array has the confidential rule. Approval_rules is empty. Delegation has max_depth 0 and child_may_expand_authority false.

Make sure not to copy identifiers into other roles unless explicit. The operator_intent mentions recipients as owner and partner, and destinations same because of recipient_and_destination. So both recipients and destinations lists have those two. But the data rule restricts confidential to owner only in destinations.

Yes, that seems right. Let's structure the JSON accordingly.
